title: Far Eastern Air Transport 103
summary: Flight 103 crashed 14 minutes after takeoff from Taipei on August 22, 1981. The aircraft had previously lost cabin pressure on August 5 and again that morning. After repairs and departure, it experienced explosive decompression and disintegrated in midair. Investigation attributed this to severe corrosion from pressurization cycles.
probable_cause: Severe corrosion from many pressurization cycles led to pressure-hull rupture.

title: Inex-Adria Aviopromet 1308
summary: [Accident] Flight JP 1308 took off from Ljubljana Airport (then Brnik Airport) at 06:41, on a chartered flight from Slovenia (at the time Yugoslavia) to Corsica's capital city of Ajaccio with 173 Slovenian passengers and 7 crew members. At 07:08, with the aircraft in Italian airspace, the controller in Padua contacted a colleague in Ajaccio, and requested an actual weather report.
